business_problem: Tufts Medicine needed to modernize its healthcare technology, eliminate traditional data-center constraints, and migrate a large Epic EHR implementation plus dozens of integrated applications without slowing patient care or operational timelines.
solution_summary: Tufts Medicine implemented its Epic electronic health record environment on AWS as part of a broad healthcare-technology modernization that replaced traditional data-center operations. The organization deployed production, disaster-recovery, and training environments across two AWS Regions with three Availability Zones per region, giving the platform multi-tiered disaster recovery for critical clinical systems. Tufts also defined its cloud estate with AWS CloudFormation and built its landing zone on AWS, which let the team compress infrastructure provisioning from months to weeks and migrate 42 business-critical third-party applications in parallel. The cloud foundation supports patient records, integrated clinical workflows, and future innovation while freeing the organization from hardware procurement and routine data-center management so teams can focus on care delivery and operational improvement.

solution_components.name: Amazon CloudWatch
